source_policy_decisions.decision: Narrow the PG405 whole-word witnesses to the printed first singular. Surface syncretism with the third singular supplies no additional witness.
Both middle words belong to the same first singular kṛp request. Record one witness for each primary history. Keep PG175’s distinct ownership labels.
Exclude the adjacent active kṛp and gup rows from the middle pair. The visible spand and spardh rows cannot establish syand or śṛdh.

Accept the combination of an independent school’s root entries, rule statements and actual handbook words within their respective grades. Wider historical usage and a rival Pāṇinian same-word licence remain Open.
